reviews.review: Been playing since 2014 and had a blast at the beginning but now? There is a crazed addiction the Devs have for a place called Deimos. It forces you to only place there and never anywhere else and everything you need for the game now is there and if you want a new warframe you have to spend hours there. The moment you feel you are done and can play somewhere else? The game pulls you back in with a possessive grip that makes you feel like a torture victim. It feels like the devs went completely away from all else in the game to focus on Deimo. Is it because they spent so much time developing it that they now will force you to only play it? I have no idea but every time I play and play hours on end? 98% of my time is spent there because all the resources I need from it, New missions I have to do, faction I need to raise and even holiday event!!! They force the community to only play there! I want to explore the rest of the game but to get what you want for it? It's always about Deimos.

Awesome live service title.  Ton of content with fun combat.  Awesome weapons and frames to collect - with plenty of builds to go after for some WILD power creep.  Great devs who communicate and interact well with the community.  Only negative I can think of is the lack of any real end game content.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Endless Action and Co-op Madness!

Warframe is an absolute blast! I love teaming up with friends (or my girlfriend) to blast through missions, unlock crazy weapons, and customize our Warframes. The gameplay is fast, fluid, and incredibly satisfying—whether you’re sliding across a map, doing wall runs, or raining down elemental powers on enemies.

The grind can feel long at times, but it’s rewarding once you unlock new gear and frames. Plus, the constant updates keep the game fresh and exciting. If you’re into cooperative action, deep customization, and sci-fi vibes, this is a must-play!

Overall my favourite franchise of all time, every update they keep on making it better with more stuff to strive for and more content to conquer. Devs are genuinely great people, they've made for quite the amazing universe with a community to back it up tenfold.
